errors.why: By SurjectiveOntoX and EventuallyAtPoints in dossier.md, the inner condition holds only at points p satisfying p.PointConditions' for x > Fm.x1 with x0 ≤ x rather than at every point p, and the property takes Fm and CH as arguments.
